phase_prompt.label: The Gathering in the East
phase_prompt.summary: The entities assemble in the eastern buffer zone, their presence generating thermal stress on the environment as they prepare to initiate conflict. They stand as a dark, unified mass against the glowing boundary of the simulation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of the faces of the Parthian and Median instigators, captured with a shallow depth of field to highlight the intense emotion and simulated fatigue on their features. Their skin texture is impeccably detailed, showing sweat that resembles cooling fluid. They are clad in dark, fiber-optic woven robes that shimmer faintly in the gloom. In the background, out of focus, the jagged, glowing lines of the eastern simulation gate provide a stark, high-contrast backdrop. The lighting is dramatic and directional, casting long shadows that obscure their eyes, reinforcing the ominous nature of their uprising.
